en.s: Battle of Shamkor (Georgian: შამქორის ბრძოლა) was fought on June 1, 1195, near the city of Shamkor, Arran. The battle was a major victory won by the Georgian army, commanded by David Soslan, over the army of the Eldiguzid ruler of Nusrat al-Din Abu Bakr. The battle was fought as part of several conflicts between the "Atabegs of Azerbaijan", also known as the Eldiguzids after its ruling dynasty, and Kingdom of Georgia.

zh.s: 沙姆科尔战役（格鲁吉亚语：შამქორის ბრძოლა）于1195年6月1日在阿兰的沙姆科尔城附近发生。格鲁吉亚军队由大卫·索斯兰率领，击败埃尔迪古兹王朝统治者努斯拉特丁·阿布·伯克尔的军队，取得重大胜利。此战是阿塞拜疆“阿塔贝格”（又称埃尔迪古兹王朝）与格鲁吉亚王国之间多场冲突之一。

en.t: Alfonso X is proclaimed king of Castile and León
en.s: Alfonso X (also known as the Wise, Spanish: el Sabio; 23 November 1221 – 4 April 1284) was King of Castile, León and Galicia from 1 June 1252 until his death in 1284. During the election of 1257, a dissident faction chose him to be king of Germany on 1 April.

zh.t: 阿方索十世被拥立为卡斯蒂利亚和莱昂国王
zh.s: 阿方索十世又称“智者”（西班牙语：el Sabio），于1221年11月23日出生，1284年4月4日去世。他从1252年6月1日起担任卡斯蒂利亚、莱昂和加利西亚国王，直至去世。1257年选举中，一个异议派别于4月1日推举他为德意志国王。

en.s: The Battle of Turaida or Treiden (also known as the Battle on Aa) was fought on June 1, 1298, on the banks of the Gauja River (German: Livländische Aa) near the Turaida Castle (Treiden). The Livonian Order was decisively defeated by the residents of Riga allied with the Grand Duchy of Lithuania under the command of Vytenis.

zh.s: 图赖达战役又称特雷登战役或阿河战役，于1298年6月1日在高亚河畔、图赖达城堡附近爆发。利沃尼亚骑士团被里加居民和立陶宛大公国组成的联军决定性击败，联军由维特尼斯指挥。

en.s: Siege of Złotoria was a siege of the castle in Złotoria, during Władysław the White's rebellion, that lasted from 1 June 1376 to early 1377. It was fought between fortified rebel forces of Władysław the White, duke of the Duchy of Gniewkowo, against attacking forces of Kingdom of Poland led by Sędziwój Pałuka, and Pomerania-Stolp led by Casimir IV.

zh.s: 兹沃托里亚围城战是白公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫起义期间对兹沃托里亚城堡的围攻，持续时间为1376年6月1日至1377年初。城堡由白公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫的叛军守卫，围攻方则是由森济沃伊·帕武卡率领的波兰王国军队和卡齐米日四世率领的波美拉尼亚—斯武普斯克军队。

en.s: Treaty of Lubowla of 1412 was a treaty between Władysław II, King of Poland, and Sigismund of Luxemburg, King of Hungary. Negotiations took place in the town of Lublo (today Stará Ľubovňa, Slovakia) and a treaty confirmed later that year in Buda.
en.n: The Treaty of Lubowla between the kingdoms of Hungary and Poland is confirmed with one of the largest and magnificent royal meetings and feasts ever held in Buda. King Sigismund of Hungary host king Władysław II Jagiełło while several thousand nobles attend.

zh.s: 1412年的卢布沃拉条约是波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫二世与匈牙利国王西吉斯蒙德之间签订的条约。双方在卢布洛（今斯洛伐克斯塔拉柳博夫尼亚）举行谈判，并于同年在布达确认条约。
zh.n: 匈牙利与波兰两国确认《卢布沃拉条约》，并在布达举行盛大王室会晤和宴会。匈牙利国王西吉斯蒙德接待波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫二世，数千名贵族到场。

en.s: The Battle of San Romano was fought on June 1st 1432, some 30 miles outside Florence, between the troops of Florence, commanded by Niccolò da Tolentino, and Siena, under Francesco Piccinino. The outcome is generally considered favourable to the Florentines, but in the Sienese chronicles it was considered a victory. As the 1430s began Florence had found itself in conflict with the rival city state of Lucca, and her allies, Siena and Milan. The Florentine deployed about 4,000 horse and 2,000 infantry. The clash, which lasted for some six or seven hours, consisted of a series of heavy cavalry fights.

zh.s: 圣罗马诺战役于1432年6月1日在佛罗伦萨城外约30英里处打响。佛罗伦萨军队由尼科洛·达·托伦蒂诺指挥，交战对手是锡耶纳军队，由弗朗切斯科·皮奇尼诺率领。通常认为佛罗伦萨获胜，但锡耶纳编年史则将此战记为胜利。1430年代初，佛罗伦萨与邻近的敌对城邦卢卡及其盟友锡耶纳和米兰发生冲突。佛军部署了约4,000名骑兵和2,000名步兵。交战持续约六七个小时，由一连串激烈的重骑兵冲锋组成。

en.s: The siege of Paris of 1435-36 took place during the decisive Lancastrian phase of the Hundred Years' War. The resurgent forces of Charles VII of France, having reversed the tide of the conflict, set their sights on capturing the capital, Paris, which had been controlled by forces loyal to Henry V of England then Henry VI of England since 1420.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1435年至1436年的巴黎围城战发生在百年战争后期。法国国王查理七世的军队扭转战局后，开始谋求夺回首都巴黎。自1420年起，巴黎一直由效忠英格兰国王亨利五世、后来效忠亨利六世的军队控制。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框所列的围城开始日期。

en.t: Anne Boleyn is crowned queen consort at Westminster Abbey
en.s: On June 1, 1533, Anne Boleyn was crowned queen consort of England at Westminster Abbey in London. Archbishop Thomas Cranmer officiated at the ceremony. Anne had married King Henry VIII earlier that year; their daughter Elizabeth was born in September and later became Elizabeth I.
en.n: June 1 is the coronation date at Westminster Abbey, not the date of Anne's marriage to Henry VIII.

zh.t: 安妮·博林在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰王后
zh.s: 1533年6月1日，安妮·博林在伦敦威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰王后，由坎特伯雷大主教托马斯·克兰麦主持仪式。安妮当年早些时候已与亨利八世成婚；他们的女儿伊丽莎白于9月出生，后来成为伊丽莎白一世。
zh.n: 6月1日是安妮在威斯敏斯特教堂的加冕日期，并非她与亨利八世的结婚日期。

en.s: The Battle of Maidstone (1 June 1648) was fought in the Second English Civil War and was a victory for the attacking parliamentarian troops over the defending Royalist forces.

zh.s: 梅德斯通战役于1648年6月1日在第二次英国内战期间发生。进攻的议会军击败了守城的保皇党军队。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Kcynia took place on June 1, 1656, and was one of battles of the Swedish invasion of Poland. It resulted in a victory of Swedish forces, commanded by King Charles X Gustav and Adolph John I, Count Palatine of Kleeburg. In the spring of 1656, Hetman Stefan Czarniecki carried out a raid in Swedish-occupied Greater Poland, in which he supported Polish guerrilla forces. On May 20, he left Uniejów, and headed northwards, to Royal Prussia, where his division joined local pospolite ruszenie, commanded by Voivode of Malbork Voivodeship, Jakub Weyher.

zh.s: 克齐尼亚战役于1656年6月1日发生，是瑞典入侵波兰期间的一场战役。瑞典军队获胜，由国王卡尔十世·古斯塔夫和克莱堡伯爵阿道夫·约翰一世指挥。1656年春，波兰指挥官斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基在瑞典占领的大波兰地区发动袭击，支援波兰游击队。5月20日，他离开乌涅尤夫向北进军普鲁士王室领地，其部队在那里与马尔堡省省督雅库布·韦伊赫尔指挥的当地民兵会合。

en.s: The Treaty of Dover, also known as the Secret Treaty of Dover, was a treaty between England and France signed at Dover on 1 June 1670. It required France to assist England in the king's aim that it would rejoin the Roman Catholic Church and England to assist France in its war of conquest against the Dutch Republic. The Third Anglo-Dutch War was a direct consequence of this treaty.

zh.s: 多佛条约又称多佛秘密条约，是英法两国于1670年6月1日在多佛签署的协议。条约规定，法国协助英国国王实现其让英国重新皈依罗马天主教的目标，英国则协助法国对荷兰共和国发动征服战争。第三次英荷战争正是该条约直接导致的结果。

en.s: The Battle of Öland was a naval battle between an allied Danish and Dutch fleet and the Swedish navy in the Baltic Sea, off the east coast of Öland on 1 June 1676. The battle was a part of the Scanian War (1675–1679) fought for supremacy over the southern Baltic.

zh.s: 厄兰岛海战于1676年6月1日在波罗的海、厄兰岛东岸附近发生，交战双方是丹麦—荷兰联军舰队和瑞典海军。这场海战是斯堪尼亚战争（1675—1679年）的一部分，双方争夺波罗的海南部的控制权。

en.s: The Battle of Drumclog was fought on 1 June 1679, between a group of Covenanters and the forces of John Graham of Claverhouse, at Drumclog, in South Lanarkshire, Scotland.

zh.s: 德拉姆克洛格战役于1679年6月1日在苏格兰南拉纳克郡的德拉姆克洛格发生，交战双方是盟约派和约翰·格雷厄姆·克拉弗豪斯率领的军队。

en.s: The Battle of Round Mountain took place on June 1, 1776, near modern-day Columbus, North Carolina, pitting the Cherokee against Patriot militia forces that received some assistance from the Catawba.

zh.s: 圆山战役于1776年6月1日在今北卡罗来纳州哥伦布附近发生。交战双方是切罗基人和爱国者民兵，后者得到了一些卡托巴人的协助。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on June 1, 1779. The delegate from Albemarle County Thomas Jefferson defeated the president of the Council of State John Page. The incumbent governor of Virginia Patrick Henry was ineligible for re-election due to term limits established by the Constitution of Virginia. The election was conducted by the Virginia General Assembly in joint session.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1779年6月1日举行州长选举。阿尔伯马尔县代表托马斯·杰斐逊击败州议会主席约翰·佩奇。时任州长帕特里克·亨利因弗吉尼亚州宪法规定的任期限制，不能竞选连任。选举由弗吉尼亚州议会两院联席会议举行。

en.t: The court-martial for malfeasance of Benedict Arnold, a general in the Continental Army during the American Revolutionary War, begins
en.s: Benedict Arnold (January 14, 1741 [O.S. January 3, 1740] – June 14, 1801) was an American-born British military officer who served during the American Revolutionary War. He fought with distinction for the American Continental Army and rose to the rank of major general before defecting to the British in 1780. General George Washington had given him his fullest trust and had placed him in command of West Point in New York.

zh.t: 美国独立战争期间，大陆军将领本尼迪克特·阿诺德因失职受军事法庭审判
zh.s: 本尼迪克特·阿诺德（1741年1月14日〔儒略历1740年1月3日〕—1801年6月14日）出生于美国，后来成为英国军官，曾参加美国独立战争。他曾为大陆军作战并屡建战功，升至少将，后于1780年叛投英国。乔治·华盛顿将军对他十分信任，曾任命他指挥纽约州西点要塞。

en.s: The Glorious First of June, also known as the Third Battle of Ushant and the Fourth Battle of Ushant, (known in France as the Bataille du 13 prairial an 2 or Combat de Prairial) was a fleet action fought on 1 June 1794 between the British and French navies during the War of the First Coalition. It was the first and largest fleet action of the French Revolutionary Wars.

zh.s: “光荣的六月一日”又称第三次乌尚海战或第四次乌尚海战（法国称“共和历二年草月十三日海战”），是第一次反法同盟战争期间英法海军于1794年6月1日进行的舰队交战。这是法国大革命战争期间规模最大的一场舰队海战，也是首场此类战斗。

en.s: In the Rhine campaign of 1796 (June 1796 to February 1797), two First Coalition armies under the overall command of Archduke Charles outmaneuvered and defeated two French Republican armies. This was the last campaign of the War of the First Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. The French military strategy against Austria called for a three-pronged invasion to surround Vienna, ideally capturing the city and forcing the Holy Roman emperor, Francis II, to surrender and accept French Revolutionary territorial integrity.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 在1796年6月至1797年2月的莱茵河战役中，卡尔大公统率的两支第一次反法同盟军击败了两支法国共和军。这是法国大革命战争期间第一次反法同盟战争的最后一场战役。法国原计划从三个方向进攻奥地利，包围并尽可能占领维也纳，迫使神圣罗马帝国皇帝弗朗茨二世投降，承认法国大革命后取得的领土。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框所列的战役开始日期。

en.s: The battle of Bunclody or Newtownbarry as it was then called, was a battle in the Irish Rebellion of 1798, which took place on 1 June 1798 when a force of approximately 5,000 rebels led by Catholic priest Fr. Mogue Kearns attacked the garrison at Bunclody. The garrison was forewarned of the approaching rebels and had prepared defensive outposts facing the rebel line of advance.

zh.s: 邦克洛迪战役又称纽敦巴里战役，于1798年6月1日在爱尔兰起义期间发生。当时，莫格·基恩神父率领约5,000名起义军进攻邦克洛迪驻军。守军提前获知起义军即将到来，已在起义军行进路线前方布置防御哨所。

en.s: The siege of Fort Bard (also known as Bard Fort) was a military action that took place during May 1800 during the second Napoleonic Italian campaign and blocked the advance of Napoleon Bonaparte's Armée de Reserve for 12 days in the narrow passage. Fort Bard was commanded by Captain Josef Stockard von Bernkopf with approximately 300 Austrian troops and 100 Sardinian soldiers.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 巴尔德堡围城战发生在1800年5月拿破仑第二次意大利战役期间。这座堡垒扼守狭窄通道，使拿破仑·波拿巴的预备军受阻12天。堡内约有300名奥地利士兵和100名撒丁士兵，由约瑟夫·施托卡德·冯·伯恩科普夫上尉指挥。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文资料框所列的围城战结束日期。

en.s: The Capture of USS Chesapeake, or the Battle of Boston Harbor, was fought on 1 June 1813, between the Royal Navy's frigate HMS Shannon and American frigate USS Chesapeake, as part of the War of 1812 between the United States and Great Britain. The Chesapeake was captured in a brief but intense action in which over 80 men were killed. This was the only frigate action of the war in which there was no preponderance of force on either side. At Boston, Captain James Lawrence took command of Chesapeake on 20 May 1813, and on 1 June, put to sea to meet the waiting HMS Shannon, the frigate whose written challenge had just missed Chesapeake's sailing.

zh.s: “切萨皮克”号被俘事件又称波士顿港海战，于1813年6月1日发生在英国皇家海军护卫舰“香农”号与美国护卫舰“切萨皮克”号之间，是1812年英美战争的一部分。战斗短暂而激烈，造成80多人死亡，最终“切萨皮克”号被俘。这是战争期间双方力量最为接近的一场护卫舰交战。1813年5月20日，詹姆斯·劳伦斯上校在波士顿接掌“切萨皮克”号。6月1日，他率舰出海迎战等待已久的“香农”号；此前对方的书面挑战刚好错过了“切萨皮克”号出航。

en.s: The Battle of Argvani was a military engagement fought between the Caucasian Imamate and the Russian Empire. The battle was fought between the detachment of Separate Caucasian Corps (Russian forces) under the command of Lieutenant General Pavel Grabbe and the detachments of Imam Shamil. It happened on 31 May 1839 in the mountain village of Argvani.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 阿尔格瓦尼战役是高加索伊玛目国与俄罗斯帝国之间的一场军事交战。俄军由帕维尔·格拉贝中将率领，隶属独立高加索军团；另一方为伊玛目沙米尔的部队。战斗于1839年5月31日在阿尔格瓦尼山村发生。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Fatshan Creek (佛山水道之戰) was a naval engagement fought between the United Kingdom's Royal Navy and the Cantonese fleet of Qing China on 1 June 1857. Commodore Henry Keppel sought out and destroyed the Chinese fleet before advancing to the city of Canton (modern-day Guangzhou) for its capture.

zh.s: 佛山水道海战（佛山水道之戰）于1857年6月1日发生，是英国皇家海军与清朝广东水师之间的一次海战。亨利·基佩尔准将主动寻找并摧毁清军舰队，随后向广州推进并准备攻占该城。

en.s: The 1857 Barossa colonial by-election was held on 1 June 1857 to elect one of two members for Barossa in the South Australian House of Assembly, after sitting member Horace Dean was unseated by the Court of Disputed Returns on 7 May 1857. Horace Dean reclaimed his seat with 42 per cent of the vote, however, he was once again removed on 13 June 1857 and replaced with the runner-up, William Bakewell.

zh.s: 南澳大利亚州议会巴罗萨选区于1857年6月1日举行补选，选出两名议员中的一名。此次补选因在任议员霍勒斯·迪恩于1857年5月7日被选举争议法庭取消议员资格而举行。迪恩以42%的得票率重新当选，但在6月13日再次被罢免，由得票第二的威廉·贝克韦尔接替。

en.s: The Revolution of the Ganhadores was a labor strike that involved African porters, known as ganhadores, in the Brazilian city of Salvador, Bahia. The strike began following the passage of a city ordinance that changed the way the ganhadores operated in the city. The strike ended in a partial victory for the strikers, as the city council replaced the ordinance with another one that did away with some of the more unpopular provisions.

zh.s: 甘哈多雷斯罢工发生在巴西巴伊亚州萨尔瓦多，参加者是被称为甘哈多雷斯的非洲裔搬运工。市政府颁布新条例，改变他们在城里的工作方式，引发罢工。市议会后来撤换了这项条例，取消其中一些最不得人心的规定，罢工者取得部分胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Arlington Mills, Virginia, was one of the first military engagements of the American Civil War, a week after the Union occupation of that part of Virginia opposite Washington, D.C. It occurred on June 1, 1861 at about 11:00 p.m., a few hours after the Battle of Fairfax Court House. Under cover of darkness, a squad of just nine Virginia soldiers fired at troops of the 1st Michigan Volunteer Infantry and the 11th New York Volunteer Infantry, who were performing picket duty at Arlington Mills, Virginia. During a brief and confused exchange of fire, one Union soldier was killed and another was wounded, while one Virginian soldier was wounded.

zh.s: 阿灵顿磨坊战役是美国内战早期的一次军事交锋，发生在联邦军占领华盛顿特区对岸的弗吉尼亚地区一周后。1861年6月1日晚上约11时，九名弗吉尼亚士兵趁夜向在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿磨坊执行警戒任务的密歇根志愿步兵第1团和纽约志愿步兵第11团开火。交火短暂而混乱，一名联邦军士兵阵亡、另一人受伤，另有一名弗吉尼亚士兵受伤。

en.s: The Battle of Fairfax Court House was one of the first land engagements of the American Civil War, when a Union scouting party clashed with the local militia in the village of Fairfax Court House, Virginia on June 1, 1861. It saw the first death in action of a Confederate officer, and the first wounding of a Confederate officer of field grade. The Union had sent a regular cavalry unit under Lieutenant Tompkins to estimate enemy numbers in the locality. At Fairfax Court House, they surprised a small Confederate rifle company under Captain Marr, and took some prisoners.

zh.t: 1861年6月费尔法克斯法院大楼战役
zh.s: 费尔法克斯法院大楼战役是美国内战早期的一次陆上交锋，1861年6月1日发生在弗吉尼亚州费尔法克斯法院大楼村。当时联邦军侦察队与当地民兵交火。此战是邦联军官首次在战斗中阵亡，也是邦联校级军官首次受伤。联邦军派托姆金斯中尉率一支正规骑兵部队侦察敌军人数。他们在费尔法克斯法院大楼突袭了马尔上尉指挥的一支小型邦联步枪连，并俘虏了数人。

en.s: The Battle of Aquia Creek was an exchange of cannon fire between Union Navy gunboats and Confederate shore batteries on the Potomac River at its confluence with Aquia Creek in Stafford County, Virginia. The battle took place from May 29, 1861 to June 1, 1861 during the early days of the American Civil War.

zh.s: 阿奎亚溪海战是联邦海军炮艇与邦联岸防炮台之间的炮击交火，发生在波托马克河与阿奎亚溪交汇处、弗吉尼亚州斯塔福德县境内。战斗从1861年5月29日持续到6月1日，是美国内战初期的一场交战。

en.s: The Battle of Seven Pines, also known as the Battle of Fair Oaks or Fair Oaks Station, took place on May 31 and June 1, 1862, in Henrico County, Virginia, as part of the Peninsula Campaign of the American Civil War. It was the culmination of an offensive up the Virginia Peninsula by Union Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan, in which the Army of the Potomac reached the outskirts of Richmond. On May 31, Confederate General Joseph E. Johnston attempted to overwhelm two Federal corps that appeared isolated south of the Chickahominy River.

zh.s: 七松树战役又称费尔奥克斯战役或费尔奥克斯车站战役，于1862年5月31日至6月1日在弗吉尼亚州亨里科县发生，是美国内战半岛战役的一部分。这场战役是联邦少将乔治·B·麦克莱伦率军沿弗吉尼亚半岛推进的高潮，波托马克军团当时已抵达里士满郊外。5月31日，邦联将军约瑟夫·E·约翰斯顿试图击溃奇卡霍米尼河以南看似孤立的两个联邦军团。

en.s: The Treaty of Bosque Redondo (Spanish for "Round Forest") also the Navajo Treaty of 1868 or Treaty of Fort Sumner, Navajo Naal Tsoos Sani or Naaltsoos Sání) was an agreement between the Navajo and the US Federal Government signed on June 1, 1868. It ended the Navajo Wars and allowed for the return of those held in internment camps at Fort Sumner following the Long Walk of 1864.

zh.s: 博斯克雷东多条约又称1868年纳瓦霍条约或萨姆纳堡条约，于1868年6月1日签署，是纳瓦霍人与美国联邦政府之间的协议。该条约结束了纳瓦霍战争，并允许在1864年“长途迁徙”后被关押在萨姆纳堡拘留营的人返回家园。博斯克雷东多在西班牙语中意为“圆形森林”；纳瓦霍语名称为Naal Tsoos Sani或Naaltsoos Sání。

en.t: Oregon votes in the 1868–69 U.S. House elections
en.s: On June 1, 1868, Oregon held its election for the U.S. House of Representatives. States voted on different dates during the 1868–69 election cycle, which chose members of the 41st Congress.

zh.s: 1868年6月1日，俄勒冈州举行美国联邦众议员选举。1868至1869年的这轮选举在各州分不同日期进行，选出第41届国会的众议员。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in France on 31 May and 1 June 1869, with a second round on 6 and 7 June. These elections nominally resulted in a victory for the regime of the Second Empire, but the opposition strengthened its presence in the legislature. Nationwide, the regime won 55% of the vote. In Paris, the opposition parties (mostly Republicans) won 75% of the vote; however, the regime won large majorities in the countryside.

zh.s: 法国于1869年5月31日和6月1日举行议会选举，第二轮投票于6月6日和7日举行。名义上，选举结果是第二帝国政府获胜，但反对派在议会中的势力有所增强。全国范围内，政府阵营赢得55%的选票。在巴黎，以共和党人为主的反对党获得75%的选票，但政府阵营仍在乡村地区赢得大量多数席位。

en.s: The 1874 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on June 1, 1874 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The election matched Republican J. C. Tolman against Democratic incumbent La Fayette Grover and independent Thomas Franklin Campbell.

en.t: 1880 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1880 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 2, 1880, with five states holding theirs early between June and October. They coincided with the 1880 presidential election which was won by James A. Garfield, who was a member of the House at the time. Elections were held for 293 seats of the United States House of Representatives, representing 38 states, to serve in the 47th United States Congress.

en.s: The 1904 Victorian state election was held in the Australian state of Victoria on 1 June 1904 to elect 67 members to the state's Legislative Assembly. It was the first election to be held in Victoria since the passing of the Constitution Act 1903 (also known as the "Constitution Reform Act"), which reduced the number of seats in the Legislative Assembly from 95 to 67 and removed all two-member electorates.

en.s: The Greek–Serbian Alliance of 1913 was signed at Thessaloniki on 1 June 1913, in the aftermath of the First Balkan War, when both countries wanted to preserve their gains in Macedonia from Bulgarian expansionism. The treaty formed the cornerstone of Greek–Serbian relations for a decade, remaining in force through World War I until 1924.

zh.s: 1913年6月1日，希腊和塞尔维亚在塞萨洛尼基签署同盟条约。第一次巴尔干战争结束后，两国希望保护在马其顿取得的成果，防止保加利亚扩张。条约成为希腊—塞尔维亚关系十年的基石，一直维持到第一次世界大战期间，并持续有效至1924年。

en.s: The Battle of Jutland (German: Skagerrakschlacht, lit. 'Battle of the Skagerrak') was a naval battle between Britain's Royal Navy Grand Fleet, under Admiral Sir John Jellicoe, and the Imperial German Navy's High Seas Fleet, under Vice-Admiral Reinhard Scheer, during the First World War. The battle unfolded in extensive manoeuvring and three main engagements from 31 May to 1 June 1916, off the North Sea coast of Denmark's Jutland Peninsula.

zh.s: 日德兰海战（德语：Skagerrakschlacht，意为“斯卡格拉克海峡之战”）是第一次世界大战期间英国皇家海军大舰队与德国帝国海军公海舰队之间的海战。英国舰队由约翰·杰利科海军上将指挥，德国舰队由莱因哈德·舍尔海军中将指挥。1916年5月31日至6月1日，双方在丹麦日德兰半岛北海沿岸附近进行了多轮机动和三场主要交战。

en.s: The Battle of Belleau Wood (1–26 June 1918) occurred during the German Spring Offensive in World War I, near the Marne River in France. The battle was fought between the U.S. 2nd (under the command of Major General Omar Bundy) and 3rd Divisions along with French and British forces against an assortment of German units including elements from the 237th, 10th, 197th, 87th, and 28th Divisions. The battle has become a key component of the lore of the United States Marine Corps.

zh.s: 贝洛森林战役于1918年6月1日至26日在法国马恩河附近爆发，是第一次世界大战德国春季攻势期间的一场战役。交战双方包括美国第2师（由奥马尔·邦迪少将指挥）和第3师，以及法英军队；对手是多个德国部队，包括第237、第10、第197、第87和第28师的部分兵力。这场战役已成为美国海军陆战队历史传统的重要组成部分。

en.s: The 1920 Copa Ibarguren was the eighth edition of this national cup of Argentina. It was played by the champions of both leagues, Boca Juniors (Primera División of dissident league Asociación Amateurs de Football), and Tiro Federal (Liga Rosarina de Football), crowned during 1920. After the first match (where Boca Juniors had won 2–1) was annulled, Tiro Federal beat Boca Juniors 4–0 in the replay match at Boca Juniors Stadium.

zh.s: 1920年伊巴古伦杯是阿根廷全国杯赛的第八届，由两大联赛的冠军参加：博卡青年（分裂派业余足球协会的甲级联赛冠军）和蒂罗联邦（罗萨里奥足球联赛冠军），两队均在1920年夺冠。首场比赛博卡青年以2比1获胜，但赛果被取消；重赛在博卡青年球场举行，蒂罗联邦以4比0击败博卡青年。

en.t: The Royal Ulster Constabulary is founded
en.s: The Royal Ulster Constabulary (RUC) was the police force of Northern Ireland from 1922 to 2001. It was founded on 1 June 1922 as a successor to the Royal Irish Constabulary (RIC) following the partition of Ireland. At its peak, the force had around 8,500 officers, with a further 4,500 who were members of the RUC Reserve.

zh.t: 皇家阿尔斯特警察队成立
zh.s: 皇家阿尔斯特警察队（RUC）是1922年至2001年间北爱尔兰的警察力量。该警队于1922年6月1日成立，是爱尔兰分治后皇家爱尔兰警察队的继承机构。鼎盛时期，该警队约有8,500名警员，另有4,500名警员在预备队服役。

en.s: The 1930 Campeonato de Portugal Final was the final match of the 1929–30 Campeonato de Portugal, the 9th season of the Campeonato de Portugal, the Portuguese football knockout tournament, organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 1 June 1930 at the Campo de Palhavã in Lisbon between Benfica and Barreirense, and the former won 3–1 after extra-time to claim their first-ever Campeonato de Portugal.

zh.s: 1930年葡萄牙锦标赛决赛是1929—30赛季葡萄牙锦标赛的最后一场比赛，也是由葡萄牙足协主办的第九届葡萄牙足球淘汰赛决赛。比赛于1930年6月1日在里斯本的帕尔哈瓦球场举行，由本菲卡对阵巴雷伦斯。本菲卡在加时赛后以3比1获胜，首次夺得葡萄牙锦标赛冠军。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Newcastle on 1 June 1935. This was triggered by the death of long-serving Labor MP David Watkins. zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院纽卡斯尔选区于1935年6月1日举行补选。此次补选因长期担任该选区议员的工党议员戴维·沃特金斯去世而举行。当时，1901年首次联邦选举当选的议员中只剩比利·休斯和参议员乔治·皮尔斯仍在世。沃特金斯的儿子戴维·奥利弗·沃特金斯赢得补选。

en.t: Prototype Focke-Wulf Fw 190 fighter makes its first flight
en.s: On June 1, 1939, the first prototype of Germany's Focke-Wulf Fw 190 fighter made its maiden flight at Bremen, with test pilot Hans Sander at the controls. The Fw 190 later entered Luftwaffe service during World War II and became one of Germany's main fighter types.

zh.s: 1939年6月1日，德国福克-沃尔夫Fw 190战斗机的首架原型机在不来梅首飞，由试飞员汉斯·桑德驾驶。Fw 190后来在第二次世界大战期间加入德国空军服役，成为德国主要战斗机之一。

en.s: The Actions in Nordland were part of the 1940 Norwegian Campaign of World War II. They were a subsidiary part of the Allied attempt to recapture Narvik. When the Germans achieved victory in the Campaigns in Central Norway, they began advancing north through Nordland to relieve the German forces isolated in Narvik.

en.s: The Battle of Crete (German: Luftlandeschlacht um Kreta, Greek: Μάχη της Κρήτης), codenamed Operation Mercury (German: Unternehmen Merkur), was a major Axis airborne and amphibious operation during World War II to capture the island of Crete. The battle began on the morning of 20 May 1941, with multiple German airborne landings on Crete; Greek and other Allied forces, along with Cretan civilians, defended the island.

zh.s: 克里特岛战役又称“水星行动”，是第二次世界大战期间轴心国为夺取克里特岛而发动的大规模空降和两栖作战。战斗于1941年5月20日上午开始，德军多处空降克里特岛。希腊军队、其他盟军和克里特当地居民共同守岛。

en.s: The German invasion of Greece or Operation Marita (German: Unternehmen Marita), were the attacks on Greece by Italy and Germany during World War II. en.s: BOAC Flight 777 was a KLM flight scheduled as a British Overseas Airways Corporation civilian airline flight from Portela Airport in Lisbon, Portugal, to Whitchurch Airport near Bristol, England. On 1 June 1943, the Douglas DC-3 serving the flight was attacked by eight German Junkers Ju 88 heavy fighter planes and crashed into the Bay of Biscay, killing all 17 on board.

en.t: Ion Antonescu, "Conducator" ("Leader") of Romania during World War II, is executed
en.s: Ion Antonescu (; Romanian: [iˈon antoˈnesku] ; 14 June [O.S. 2 June] 1882 – 1 June 1946) was a Romanian military officer and marshal who presided over two successive wartime dictatorships as Prime Minister and Conducător during most of World War II. en.s: The Chinchaga fire, also known as the Wisp fire, Chinchaga River fire and Fire 19, was a forest fire that burned in northern British Columbia and Alberta in the summer and early fall of 1950. With a final size of between 1,400,000 and 1,700,000 hectares (3,500,000 and 4,200,000 acres; 5,400 and 6,600 mi2), it is the single largest recorded fire in North American history.
en.n: The Chinchaga fire ignites. By September, it would become the largest single fire on record in North America.

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 1 June 1958. The result was a victory for the Christian Social Party, which won 104 of the 212 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 53 of the 106 seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was 93.6% in the Chamber election and 93.7% in the Senate election. Elections for the nine provincial councils were also held. The election took place in a political crisis known as the Second School War. The outgoing anti-clerical "purple" government of the Socialist and Liberal Party, led by Achille Van Acker, reversed policies of the previous Catholic-led government regarding private schools.

zh.s: 比利时于1958年6月1日举行大选。基督教社会党获胜，在众议院212席中赢得104席，在参议院106席中赢得53席。众议院选举投票率为93.6%，参议院选举为93.7%。九个省议会也同时举行选举。此次选举发生在被称为“第二次学校战争”的政治危机期间。即将卸任的社会主义者和自由党组成的反教权“紫色”政府由阿希尔·范阿克领导，推翻了前一届天主教政府有关私立学校的政策。

en.s: Early general elections were held in Sweden on 1 June 1958, after the defeat of the Social Democratic government's proposals for a new pensions system in a parliamentary vote. The Social Democrats remained the largest party, winning 111 of the 231 seats in the Second Chamber of the Riksdag, and Tage Erlander's third government was returned to power. In accordance with the law, the new Chamber was elected only to complete the previous Chamber's term, which was due to end in 1960.

zh.s: 瑞典于1958年6月1日提前举行大选，原因是社会民主党政府提出的新养老金制度方案在议会投票中遭否决。社会民主党仍是最大党，在瑞典议会第二院的231个席位中赢得111席，塔格·埃兰德领导的第三届政府继续执政。根据法律，新一届第二院只完成上一届任期，任期至1960年结束。

en.t: Adolf Eichmann is executed in Israel
en.s: On June 1, 1962, Adolf Eichmann was executed by hanging at a prison in Ramla, Israel, following his conviction for crimes committed during the Holocaust.
en.n: The execution took place around midnight on the night of May 31–June 1. This entry follows the June 1 date used by the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum.

zh.s: 1962年6月1日，阿道夫·艾希曼在以色列拉姆拉的一所监狱被处以绞刑。他此前因在纳粹大屠杀中犯下的罪行被判有罪。
zh.n: 处决发生在5月31日至6月1日午夜前后。本条采用美国大屠杀纪念馆记载的6月1日。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 1 June 1963 to elect the 78 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The major parties contesting the election were the Country Party led by Premier Frank Nicklin, the Liberal Party led by Alan Munro, the Labor Party led by Jack Duggan and the Queensland Labor Party led by Paul Hilton.

zh.s: 澳大利亚昆士兰州于1963年6月1日举行选举，选出州立法议会78名议员。主要参选政党包括由州长弗兰克·尼克林领导的乡村党、艾伦·芒罗领导的自由党、杰克·杜根领导的工党，以及保罗·希尔顿领导的昆士兰工党。

en.s: The Irish presidential election of 1966 was the fifth presidential election in Ireland and was held on 1 June 1966. Outgoing president Éamon de Valera, 83 and with a rapidly deteriorating eyesight, reluctantly agreed under pressure from his Fianna Fáil party to seek a second term. Fine Gael decided to run one of its younger TDs, Tom O'Higgins, against him. In an astonishing upset, O'Higgins came within 1% (or 10,000 votes) of defeating de Valera. De Valera left the blame for this near-defeat with his campaign manager Charles Haughey.

zh.s: 爱尔兰于1966年6月1日举行第五次总统选举。卸任总统埃蒙·德瓦莱已83岁，视力迅速恶化，在其共和党施压下，他不情愿地同意竞选连任。统一党决定派较年轻的议员汤姆·奥希金斯参选。选举结果出人意料，奥希金斯仅以不到1个百分点（约10,000票）的差距败给德瓦莱。德瓦莱将这场险胜归咎于竞选经理查尔斯·豪伊。

en.s: General elections were held in the Dominican Republic on 1 June 1966. Following the 1963 coup which toppled elected president Juan Bosch of the Dominican Revolutionary Party, supporters of his constitutional reforms were excluded from the elections, although Bosch himself contested them. The result was a victory for Joaquín Balaguer of the Reformist Party, whilst his party also won the Congressional elections. Voter turnout was 75.6%.

zh.s: 多米尼加共和国于1966年6月1日举行大选。1963年政变推翻了由多米尼加革命党当选的总统胡安·博施后，支持其宪政改革的人士被排除在选举之外，但博施本人仍参加了竞选。改革党候选人华金·巴拉格尔获胜，该党也赢得国会选举。投票率为75.6%。

en.t: The Heimlich maneuver for rescuing choking victims is published in the journal Emergency Medicine
en.s: The Heimlich maneuver (spelled manoeuvre in British English), also known as an abdominal thrust, is a first-aid procedure used to treat upper-airway obstructions (or choking) by foreign objects. American doctor Henry Heimlich is often credited for its development. To perform a Heimlich maneuver, a rescuer stands behind a choking victim and uses their hands to apply pressure to the bottom of the victim's diaphragm.

zh.s: 海姆立克急救法（英式拼法为Heimlich manoeuvre），又称腹部冲击法，是一种通过异物梗阻患者身后施压来处理上呼吸道异物梗阻或窒息的急救方法。美国医生亨利·海姆立克通常被认为是该方法的发明者。施救者站在患者身后，用双手向其膈肌下方施压。

en.t: Patriotic Union of Kurdistan issues its founding declaration
en.s: A founding declaration of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan is dated June 1, 1975. The six-page handwritten document set out the new Kurdish party's political aims after the collapse of an earlier Kurdish uprising in Iraq. It is signed by the party's founding committee; the University of Exeter archive identifies the manuscript as written in Jalal Talabani's hand. The party commemorates June 1 as its founding date.
en.n: The preserved founding declaration is dated June 1, 1975. Accounts differ on where the party's founding announcements took place, so no city is assigned here.

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 418 was an international passenger flight from Luanda to Moscow Sheremetyevo with three intermediate stops. On 1 June 1976, the Tupolev Tu-154A (CCCP-85102) operating the first leg of the flight, collided with Mount San Carlos of Bioko Island while en route. All 46 occupants on board were killed as a result of the crash.

en.s: The Cod Wars (Icelandic: Þorskastríðin; also known as Landhelgisstríðin, lit. 'The Coastal Wars'; German: Kabeljaukriege) were a series of 20th-century confrontations between Iceland and the United Kingdom (with aid from West Germany) about fishing rights in the North Atlantic around Iceland. Each of the disputes ended with an Icelandic victory. Fishing boats from Britain had been sailing to waters near Iceland in search of catch since the 14th century.

en.s: The Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) is an international patent law treaty, concluded in 1970. It provides a unified procedure for filing patent applications to protect inventions in each of its contracting states. A patent application filed under the PCT is called an international application, or PCT application. A single filing of a PCT application is made with a Receiving Office (RO) in one language.
en.n: The first international applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty are filed.

zh.n: 首批依据《专利合作条约》提交的国际申请递交。

en.s: The Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty (INF Treaty) was an arms control treaty between the United States and the Soviet Union (and its successor state, the Russian Federation). US president Ronald Reagan and Soviet General Secretary Mikhail Gorbachev signed the treaty on 8 December 1987. The US Senate approved the treaty on 27 May 1988, and Reagan and Gorbachev ratified it on 1 June 1988.
en.n: The Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty comes into effect.

zh.s: 《中程核力量条约》（INF条约）是美国与苏联（以及其继承国俄罗斯联邦）之间的军备控制条约。美国总统罗纳德·里根和苏联共产党总书记米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫于1987年12月8日签署条约。美国参议院于1988年5月27日批准条约，里根和戈尔巴乔夫于1988年6月1日批准该条约。
zh.n: 《中程核力量条约》生效。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Burundi on 1 June 1993 following the approval of a new constitution in a referendum the previous year. They were the first multi-party elections for the presidency, the only previous elections in 1984 having been held at a time when the country was a one-party state. This election was a watershed for Burundi, representing the end of a military backed Tutsi state, and the birth of democracy. Three candidates entered the contest, with Melchior Ndadaye of the Front for Democracy in Burundi defeating incumbent President Pierre Buyoya with 66% of the vote. Voter turnout was 97.3%.

zh.s: 布隆迪于1993年6月1日举行总统选举，这是前一年通过新宪法后举行的选举，也是该国首次多党总统选举。此前唯一一次总统选举在1984年举行，当时布隆迪仍实行一党制。此次选举是布隆迪的转折点，标志着军方支持的图西族政权结束，民主政治开始。三名候选人参选，布隆迪民主阵线的梅尔基奥尔·恩达达耶以66%的选票击败时任总统皮埃尔·布约亚。投票率为97.3%。

en.s: The Dobrinja mortar attack was a massacre which occurred at 10:20 a.m. on 1 June 1993, in Dobrinja, a suburb west of Sarajevo in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Two mortars were fired from Serb-held positions, hitting a football pitch where youths put on an impromptu game on the first day of the Muslim holiday Kurban Bajram. Approximately 200 people were in attendance to watch the game. The United Nations placed the official death toll stemming from the mortar attack at 13 (news reports at the time published numbers ranging from 11 to 15 deaths), with 133 wounded.

zh.s: 1993年6月1日上午10时20分，波黑首都萨拉热窝以西郊区多布林亚发生迫击炮袭击，造成多人遇难。两枚迫击炮弹从塞族控制的阵地发射，击中一处足球场。当时正值穆斯林宰牲节首日，一群年轻人在场上临时踢球，约200人到场观看。联合国公布的官方死亡人数为13人；当时新闻报道的数字为11至15人不等，另有133人受伤。

en.s: The World Wrestling Peace Festival was a professional wrestling supercard produced by Japanese professional wrestler Antonio Inoki, which took place on June 1, 1996 at the Los Angeles Sports Arena in Los Angeles, California. The event was organized by Inoki to promote world peace with an interpromotional event involving major promotions from around the world. Forty wrestlers from six countries ended up taking part in the event. Inoki's home promotion New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW), as well as smaller independent groups, represented Japan and World Championship Wrestling (WCW) took part on behalf of the United States.

zh.s: 世界摔角和平节是日本职业摔角手安东尼奥·猪木主办的一场职业摔角大型赛事，于1996年6月1日在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶体育馆举行。猪木组织这场跨推广联盟赛事，旨在促进世界和平，多家世界各地的重要摔角联盟参加。最终共有来自六个国家的40名摔角手参赛。猪木所属的新日本职业摔角以及几家规模较小的独立团体代表日本参赛，世界冠军摔角联盟代表美国参赛。

en.s: General elections were held in Bolivia on 1 June 1997. As no candidate for the presidency received over 50% of the vote, the National Congress was required to elect a President on 4 August. Hugo Banzer of Nationalist Democratic Action (ADN) was subsequently elected. Whilst the ADN emerged as the largest party in Congress, it failed to win a majority of seats, and formed a coalition government with the Revolutionary Left Movement, Conscience of Fatherland and the Civic Solidarity Union.

zh.s: 玻利维亚于1997年6月1日举行大选。没有总统候选人获得超过50%的选票，因此国民议会须于8月4日选出总统。民族主义民主行动党的乌戈·班塞尔随后当选。该党在国会中成为最大党，但未获多数席位，于是与革命左翼运动、祖国良知党和公民团结联盟组成联合政府。

en.s: A French legislative election took place on 25 May and 1 June 1997 to elect the 11th National Assembly of the Fifth Republic. It was the consequence of President Jacques Chirac's decision to call the legislative election one year before the deadline. In March 1993, the right won a large victory in the legislative election and a comfortable parliamentary majority. Two years later, the RPR leader Jacques Chirac was elected President of France promising to reduce the "social fracture". However, the programme of welfare reforms ("Plan Juppé") proposed by his Prime Minister Alain Juppé caused a social crisis in November and December 1995.

zh.s: 法国于1997年5月25日和6月1日举行立法选举，选出第五共和国第11届国民议会。这次提前选举源于总统雅克·希拉克决定提前一年举行选举。1993年3月的立法选举中，右翼大胜并获得稳固的议会多数。两年后，保卫共和联盟领导人希拉克当选总统，承诺缓解“社会裂痕”。然而，他的总理阿兰·于佩提出的福利改革计划（“于佩计划”）在1995年11月至12月引发社会危机。

en.s: American Airlines Flight 1420 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) to Little Rock National Airport in the United States. On Tuesday, June 1st, 1999, the McDonnell Douglas MD-82 operating as Flight 1420 overran the runway upon landing in Little Rock and crashed. 9 of the 145 people aboard were immediately killed—the captain and eight passengers—and 2 more passengers died in the hospital in the following weeks.

zh.s: 美国航空1420号班机是从达拉斯—沃思堡国际机场飞往美国小石城国家机场的定期国内客运航班。1999年6月1日星期二，执飞航班的麦克唐纳·道格拉斯MD-82在小石城降落时冲出跑道并坠毁。机上145人中有9人当场死亡，包括机长和8名乘客；另有2名乘客在随后几周内于医院不治。

en.s: The Dolphinarium discotheque massacre was a Hamas terrorism attack on 1 June 2001 in which a Hamas-affiliated Islamist terrorist blew himself up outside a nightclub in Tel Aviv, Israel, killing 21 Israelis, 16 of them teenagers. The majority of the victims were teenage girls, whose families had recently immigrated from the former Soviet Union.

en.s: The Nepalese royal massacre (also called Durbar Hatyakanda, दरबार हत्याकाण्ड) was a mass shooting which occurred on 1 June 2001 (19 Jestha 2058 Nepal B.S.) at the Narayanhiti Palace, the then-residence of the Nepali monarchy, resulting in the deaths of nine members of the royal family, including King Birendra and Queen Aishwarya. A government-appointed inquiry team named Crown Prince Dipendra as the perpetrator of the massacre.

zh.s: 尼泊尔王室大屠杀又称“杜巴尔宫惨案”，于2001年6月1日（尼泊尔历2058年杰斯塔月19日）在当时的尼泊尔王室住所纳拉扬希蒂王宫发生。枪击导致九名王室成员死亡，包括比兰德拉国王和艾西瓦娅王后。政府任命的调查小组认定王储迪彭德拉是凶手。

en.s: The 2003 National Soccer League Grand Final was held on 1 June 2003 between Perth Glory and Olympic Sharks at Subiaco Oval. en.s: Cyclone Gonu (IMD designation: ARB 01, JTWC designation: 02A, also known as Super Cyclonic Storm Gonu) is the strongest tropical cyclone on record in the Arabian Sea, and is also the strongest named cyclone in the northern Indian Ocean. The second named tropical cyclone of the 2007 North Indian Ocean cyclone season, Gonu developed from a persistent area of convection in the eastern Arabian Sea on June 1, 2007. With a favorable upper-level environment and warm sea surface temperatures, it rapidly intensified to attain peak winds of 240 km/h (150 mph) on June 3, according to the India Meteorological Department.

zh.s: 古努气旋（印度气象局编号ARB 01，联合台风警报中心编号02A，也称超级气旋风暴古努）是阿拉伯海有记录以来最强的热带气旋，也是北印度洋有名称气旋中最强的一次。它是2007年北印度洋气旋季第二个获命名的热带气旋，于2007年6月1日在阿拉伯海东部由持续的对流区发展形成。在有利的高空环境和温暖海面温度影响下，气旋迅速增强。印度气象局记录显示，它于6月3日达到峰值风速每小时240公里（每小时150英里）。

en.s: One Night Stand (2008) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) that took place on June 1, 2008, at the San Diego Sports Arena in San Diego. It was the fourth and final event promoted under the One Night Stand name. The event featured talent from the Raw, SmackDown, and ECW brands. The main match on the SmackDown! brand was a Tables, Ladders, and Chairs match for the vacant World Heavyweight Championship between Edge and The Undertaker, which Edge won after retrieving the belt suspended above the ring. Per the pre-match stipulation, Undertaker was forced to leave the WWE.

zh.s: 《一夜惊喜》（2008年）是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）主办的一场职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2008年6月1日在加利福尼亚州圣迭戈体育馆举行。这是最后一届以“一夜惊喜”为名的赛事，也是该品牌举办的第四届赛事。来自Raw、SmackDown和ECW品牌的选手均参加了比赛。SmackDown品牌的主赛是空缺的世界重量级冠军赛，采用桌梯椅赛制，由Edge对阵送葬者。Edge取下悬挂在擂台上方的冠军腰带获胜。根据赛前约定，送葬者必须离开WWE。

en.s: On June 1, 2008, a fire broke out on the backlot of Universal Studios Hollywood, an American film studio and theme park in the San Fernando Valley area of Los Angeles County, California. The fire began when a worker used a blowtorch to warm asphalt shingles that were being applied to a facade. The worker left before checking that all spots had cooled, and as a result, a three-alarm fire broke out.

zh.s: 2008年6月1日，好莱坞环球影城片场发生火灾。片场位于加利福尼亚州洛杉矶县圣费尔南多谷地区的一家电影制片厂和主题公园内。一名工人用喷灯加热正在铺设于外墙上的沥青屋面瓦后离开，没有确认所有部位都已冷却，结果引发三级火灾。

en.s: The 2008 Puerto Rico Democratic presidential primary took place on June 1, 2008. It was an open primary. Puerto Rico initially planned to hold caucuses, as was done in 2000 and 2004, on June 7, 2008. In December 2007, an error in the plan was discovered; the caucus date should have read June 1, 2008. Puerto Rico also decided to conduct a primary, rather than caucuses.

en.s: Air France Flight 447 was a scheduled international transatlantic passenger flight from Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, to Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport, France, that crashed into the mid-Atlantic Ocean on 1 June 2009, killing all 228 passengers and crew on board. The incident, which occurred on an Airbus A330, happened because inconsistent airspeed indications and resulting miscommunication between the pilots led to an unrecoverable stall.

zh.s: 法国航空447号班机是一趟从巴西里约热内卢飞往法国巴黎戴高乐机场的定期国际跨大西洋客运航班。2009年6月1日，空客A330客机在大西洋中部坠毁，机上228名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。事故发生的原因是空速指示不一致以及飞行员之间沟通失误，最终导致飞机无法恢复的失速。

en.s: Operation Mar Lewe was a three-day International Security Assistance Force operation started in the early hours of Friday 29 May 2009 when the Taliban were attacked as the Afghan Security Forces and British Army struck at enemy positions around the village of Yatimchay, 6 kilometres (3.7 mi) south of Musa Qaleh, Helmand Province, Afghanistan. "Mar Lewe" is Pashto for "snake wolf".

en.s: The 61st FIFA Congress was held between 31 May and 1 June 2011 at the Hallenstadion in Zurich, Switzerland. FIFA is the governing body of world association football, and the congress is the annual meeting of FIFA's supreme legislative body. This is the eighth congress to be held in Zurich, and the first since 2007. After an opening ceremony and a reminder of FIFA events and activities in 2010, the second day witnessed decisions taken, and the unveiling of the 2010 financial results. The opening ceremony was presented by Melanie Winiger, and featured singer Grace Jones, hammered dulcimer player Nicolas Senn, and juggler Alan Sulc.

zh.s: 第61届国际足联大会于2011年5月31日至6月1日在瑞士苏黎世的哈伦体育馆举行。国际足联是世界足球运动的管理机构，其大会是组织最高立法机构的年度会议。这是大会第八次在苏黎世举行，也是自2007年以来首次重返当地。首日举行开幕仪式，并回顾国际足联2010年的活动和赛事。第二天作出各项决定，并公布2010年财务结果。开幕式由梅拉妮·维尼格主持，表演嘉宾包括歌手格蕾丝·琼斯、扬琴演奏者尼古拉斯·森和杂耍艺人阿兰·苏尔奇。

en.s: On the afternoon of June 1, 2011, an unusually long-tracked and powerful tornado caused significant damage in Hampden and Worcester Counties in Western and Central Massachusetts, including the city of Springfield, resulting in three fatalities (plus one indirect fatality), at least 200 injuries, and over 500 families being left homeless.

zh.s: 2011年6月1日下午，一场路径异常长、威力强大的龙卷风袭击马萨诸塞州西部和中部的汉普登县与伍斯特县，包括斯普林菲尔德市。灾害造成3人死亡（另有1人间接死亡）、至少200人受伤，500多个家庭无家可归。

en.s: The 2013 Riga City Council election was held on 1 June 2013, to elect Riga City Council, the unicameral local legislature of the Riga, as part of municipal elections across the country. At stake were all 60 seats in the City Council. After 2009 elections Harmony created coalition with Christian-Democratic LPP/LC and Nils Ušakovs became Mayor of Riga. Ušakovs' popularity among Rigans had grown steadily, and 73% of the city's residents approved of Ušakovs' performance in December 2010. In 2011, LPP/LC party was dissolved and Harmony started ruling alone.

zh.s: 里加于2013年6月1日举行市议会选举，选出里加市议会全体60个席位。这是全国地方选举的一部分。2009年选举后，和谐党与基督教民主党政党联盟LPP/LC组成联合政府，尼尔斯·乌沙科夫斯出任里加市长。乌沙科夫斯在里加居民中的支持率持续上升；2010年12月，73%的市民认可他的工作表现。2011年，LPP/LC解散，和谐党开始单独执政。

en.s: The 2013 DFB-Pokal final was an association football match that took place on 1 June 2013 between Bayern Munich and VfB Stuttgart at the Olympiastadion in Berlin to decide the winners of the 2012–13 DFB-Pokal. Bayern Munich won the game 3–2, claiming the cup for the 16th time. The win, combined with earlier titles in the Champions League and Bundesliga, allowed Bayern Munich to complete a continental treble.

zh.s: 2013年德国足协杯决赛于2013年6月1日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行，由拜仁慕尼黑对阵斯图加特，决出2012—13赛季德国足协杯冠军。拜仁以3比2获胜，第16次捧起德国杯。此前，拜仁已赢得欧冠和德甲冠军，此胜使球队完成欧洲三冠王。

en.s: The Cupa României final was the final match of the 2012–13 Cupa României, played between Petrolul Ploiești and CFR Cluj. The match was played on 1 June 2013 at the Arena Națională in Bucharest. Petrolul Ploiești won the match 1–0, triumphing for the 3rd time in this competition while CFR Cluj lost its first final. It was the second final played on the Arena Națională and the second in Bucharest since 2006.

zh.s: 2013年罗马尼亚杯决赛是2012—13赛季赛事的最后一场比赛，由普洛耶什蒂石油对阵克卢日铁路，于2013年6月1日在布加勒斯特国家竞技场举行。普洛耶什蒂石油以1比0获胜，第三次夺得该项赛事冠军；克卢日铁路则首次在决赛中失利。这是自2006年以来第二次在布加勒斯特国家竞技场举行的决赛，也是第二次在布加勒斯特举行。

en.s: Payback (2014) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It took place on June 1, 2014 at the Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois It was the second WWE pay-per-view held under the Payback name, the first having been held in 2013 at the same venue. Nine matches (including the pre-show) took place at the event. In the main event, The Shield (Dean Ambrose, Seth Rollins and Roman Reigns) defeated Evolution (Triple H, Randy Orton and Batista) in a No Holds Barred six-man tag team elimination match. It was the first WWE pay-per-view since Armageddon (2006) not to feature a World Championship match.

zh.s: 《回报》（2014年）是WWE主办的一场职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2014年6月1日在伊利诺伊州罗斯蒙特的奥尔斯泰特竞技场举行。这是第二届以“回报”为名的WWE按次付费赛事；首届于2013年在同一场馆举行。本次赛事共进行了九场比赛，包括预演赛。主赛中，盾牌军团（迪安·安布罗斯、塞思·罗林斯和罗曼·雷恩斯）在一场不设限制的三对三淘汰赛中击败进化军团（Triple H、兰迪·奥顿和巴蒂斯塔）。这是自2006年《末日》以来，首场没有世界冠军头衔赛的WWE按次付费赛事。

en.s: The 2014 FA Women's Cup final was the 44th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the 21st to be played directly under the auspices of the Football Association (FA). The final was contested between Arsenal and Everton on 1 June 2014 at stadium:mk in Milton Keynes. This was the last cup final held outside Wembley Stadium.

zh.s: 2014年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是该项英格兰女子足球主要杯赛的第44届决赛，也是英格兰足球总会直接主办的第21届决赛。比赛于2014年6月1日在米尔顿凯恩斯的MK球场举行，由阿森纳对阵埃弗顿。这是最后一场在温布利球场以外举行的足总杯决赛。

en.s: The 2015 Hazfi Cup final was the 28th final since 1975. The match was contested by Zob Ahan and Naft Tehran at Takhti Stadium in Tehran. The match was played on 1 June 2015 and was the final match of the competition. Zob Ahan won 3–1 and won their third title in the competition. They also qualified for the group stages of the 2016 AFC Champions League.

zh.s: 2015年哈兹菲杯决赛是自1975年以来的第28场决赛，由佐布阿汉对阵德黑兰石油，比赛在德黑兰塔赫蒂体育场举行。决赛于2015年6月1日进行，也是本届赛事的最后一场比赛。佐布阿汉以3比1获胜，第三次赢得该项赛事冠军，并获得2016年亚冠联赛小组赛资格。

en.t: 2021 New Mexico's 1st congressional district special election
en.s: A special election was held on June 1, 2021, to fill the vacancy in New Mexico's 1st congressional district created by Representative Deb Haaland's resignation from the United States House of Representatives to become the Secretary of the Interior in Joe Biden's administration. State Representatives Patricia Roybal Caballero, Georgene Louis and Melanie Stansbury and state Senator Antoinette Sedillo Lopez sought the Democratic nomination.

en.t: South Korea holds its eighth nationwide local elections
